'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Peter Tenneson DS Hunt Down''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Peter Tenneson]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Last time I can use this deck. Peter Tenneson / patmagrain, 2014 Worlds Day 2 08/23/14, 2010 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Username:''' patmagrain
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
